title: Context-conflict safeguards for confidence-aware intelligent matching
scope: Arabic-aware multi-evidence identity ranking and safe identity decisions for employees across homepage, employee directory, movement forms, assistant and screenshot ticket matching; scoped confirmed aliases and no automatic writes from fuzzy matches. Added conflict blocking when a unique identity code contradicts fuzzy employee-name, basic-branch or governorate context.

contract_test_summary: 272 contract tests passed for v68.36.0. 15 isolated matcher behavior tests were invoked directly; five runtime contract checks cover exact-code conflicts with fuzzy employee-name, basic-branch and governorate context plus safe handling of spelling noise. 46 Jinja templates, 8 JavaScript files, 6 CSS files and 172 Python files passed syntax checks. UI integrity, 59 POST route checks and 13 homepage/workflow contracts passed. Full Flask integration tests could not start because Flask is absent in the review environment.

backend_business_logic_changed: Added conservative context conflict blocking to the shared identity resolver. A unique code/name cannot prefill a record if fuzzy employee-name, basic-branch or governorate context strongly points to another authorized candidate; exact governorate mismatch is checked alongside branch context. Similarity is used to block unsafe prefill only, never to auto-select an alternative. No deployment or production database changes.

css_cleanup.method: Removed only CSS rules whose complete declaration sets were provably superseded by later declarations for the same selector and matching at-rule context; retained unique or uncertain rules. Changed a defined set of legacy charcoal color remnants to shared light/cyan theme tokens. Did not blindly remove all !important declarations.
css_cleanup.sidebar: light white/cyan surface with dark readable nav text and a low-glow active state
